description: This file defines the internal class GrainLocatorResolver, which manages and resolves grain locators based on grain types within the Orleans runtime, utilizing dependency injection and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: GrainLocatorResolver
classes.description: Manages resolution of grain locators based on grain type, utilizing caching and dependency injection.

methods.name: GetGrainLocator
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a grain locator for the specified grain type, using caching.

methods.name: GetGrainLocatorInternal
methods.description: Determines the appropriate grain locator for a given grain type, considering if it's a client, default directory, or cached locator.
